rate.note: each of these is a real, merged code change whose before/after is recoverable from git, which is the only shape here a shaper could learn from; the repo currently throws that shape away by keeping the lesson and not the change

controller_checkpoints.why: this is the only source with a natural pass/fail split and a committed `expect`; it is thin (hundreds, not thousands) and narrow (about twenty capabilities), so it is a seed, not a dataset

execution_receipts.why: a receipt records that a module was invoked and what it returned; it holds no situation the machine was in and no choice it made, so there is nothing for a shaper to condition on or to predict. Zero units is not a small number, it is a missing shape.

taught_action_corpora.why: a lesson is a rule, not an event. The demonstration it was learned from is not kept with it, so the (before, after, outcome) triples cannot be recovered from the store -- they would have to be re-fetched from the pull requests they came from

trajectory_store.why: every record is hand-seeded, every outcome is `success`, and the four steps are the same four for all of them; a store that cannot express a failure cannot teach a policy where to stop, which is the thing a shaper most needs to learn
